trials.role: Randomized Arm VII: BOLD-100 (sodium salt) with FOLFOX-based therapy vs FOLFOX-based therapy alone in second-line metastatic colorectal cancer
trials.enrollment_update: Arm VII: 60 of 120 planned participants enrolled as of October 15, 2026.
trials.outcome: Phase 1b interim dose escalation of BOLD-100 with FOLFOX at 420, 500 and 625 mg/m². Two dose-limiting toxicities were reported: grade 3–4 neutropenia with fever or infection at 500 mg/m², and inability to receive planned doses due to adverse events at 625 mg/m². One serious event (dyspnea) was reported as related to BOLD-100.

trials.role: IT-139 / NKP-1339 (sodium salt), intravenous monotherapy in advanced solid tumours
trials.outcome: 46 treated across nine dose levels. Maximum tolerated dose: 625 mg/m² on days 1, 8 and 15 of a 28-day cycle. Among 38 efficacy-evaluable participants, 1 partial response and 9 with stable disease. No treatment-related deaths were reported. Five of 46 patients experienced dose-limiting toxicity, and dose-limiting events at 780 mg/m² exceeded the protocol threshold. The most frequent treatment-emergent events were nausea (48%), fatigue (46%) and vomiting (39%).

toxicity.Notes: Hudej et al., pp. 2056–2059, Fig. 1 and Fig. 3, Methods and Results. SA-1 fibrosarcoma-bearing mice, KP1339 monotherapy arms after a single i.v. injection in the orbital sinus. Ten animals per group. Authors explicitly report no deaths before protocol euthanasia at approximately 350 mm³ tumour volume. Survival at the protocol endpoint is 100% across the three doses; follow-up was tumour-volume dependent, without a common fixed mortality cutoff. KP1339-treated arms collectively lost up to 10% of body weight in the first two days. LD50 and MTD were not determined.

logp.method_description: Distribution coefficients (D7.4) were determined by the shake flask method (37) using n-octanol and PBS. The sodium-compensated complexes 1b, 2b, and 3b, as well as Na[RuCl4Py2], Na[RuCl4Him2], and Na[RuCl4Hind2] (NKP-1339) were dissolved in n-octanol presaturated PBS to give 200 μM solutions; 3b and NKP-1339 were dissolved in DMSO to improve solubility and then added to PBS to give a 1% DMSO solution. The aqueous solutions and n-octanol in 1:1 v/v ratio were mixed with an orbital shaker for 2 h at 25 °C. The mixtures were then centrifuged at 5000 rpm for 3 min at 25 °C. UV–vis spectra were taken at room temperature of the aqueous phase before and after shaking, and the absorbance at λmax was compared to ascertain the value of D7.4.
